note: SCB has no year-range label that stays a plain interval: a month range ('2022-01 - 2024-12') is the one multi-year Registerversionnamn that `source_scopes` reads as an interval rather than a pooled range, so it stands in for the old test's explicit 2022-2024 interval scope.
fails_if: `form_representations` marks the shared parallel state pooled when any member is pooled, rather than only when all are (or copies First's pooled flag onto Second's states), so the 2022 or 2023-2024 state reads pooled

sources.description: Variable 1 (Income): First is pooled 2020-2022 (CVID 100); Second is the month-range interval 2022-01 - 2024-12 (CVID 101).
